newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates slip at close, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates slip at close, seen down.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money rates slipped on Saturday to close at 4.0 percent because of surplus funds and will remain low on Sunday as well, dealers said.
"After a long time, the week opened on a liquid note owing to surplus of funds in the banking system," said a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank.

He said initial deals were made at 15 percent, but the rates dropped to 8.0 percent on lack of borrowing interest. "At the end of the day, the market was seen more or less square at 4.0 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
